snippet.textDisplay: I think it's especially difficult for someone like Speed, who became famous as a child, to navigate through those feelings. Cus so many people know him, but don't know him as a person, they only know his streaming persona. And part of his job is to clip farm and basically exploit his own life for content. So when he at a point where he exploit himself but also gets exploited by everyone that makes money of him and his persona, it probably gets lonely and tiring at some point. People around him will try to get at him for money and fame, and the only ppl he can really rely on are his family and his close close friends (which probably mostly includes a few content creators but not many), so who does he rlly have? He does have himself but at what cost. We're humans which is why we have a need for community and connection, but a fanbase isn't a real community.
